name: PopCon Indy
blurb: Indianapolis' pop-culture and comic convention, bringing film/TV actors, anime voice actors, comic artists and authors to the Indiana Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage/guests page text: "March 26 - 28, 2027 Indiana Convention Center"

notes: Special Guests page groups guests under on-site tabs Actors / Voice Actors / Content Creators / Comic Book / Authors. Several guest-card background images were reused/mismatched stock photos whose filenames named a different role than the card's own caption text (e.g. Christine Marie Cabanos's image file said 'Sailor Saturn' but her card text said 'Madoka Kaname'). Verify-03 pass (2026-10-05) wrongly called this current from the page's own date banner, which is a template-level signal, not per-guest proof. Refute pass (2026-10-05): refuted -> none-yet -- the page's own just-completed edition was PopCon Indy, May 8-10, 2026 (confirmed via listings/press), whose published lineup (Sean Astin, Diedrich Bader, Dee Bradley Baker, Linda Ballantyne, Erik Braa, Christine Marie Cabanos, Clifford Chapin, Leah Clark, Caitlin Glass, Jessie James Grelle, Katie Griffin, Walter Jones, Mara Junot, Gabe Kunda, Lauren Landa, Alan Lee, David Matranga, Joel McDonald, Kristen McGuire, Monica Rial, Matthew David Rudd, Stuart Sayger, Keith Silverstein, Gavin Smith, Patrick Warburton, Billy West) names all 26 of those same people among the 48 still shown here; a fresh re-extract shows every one of the 48 card images was uploaded between 2024 and May 2026, with none dated after that May 2026 show -- the grid has not been touched since, so this is the May 2026 lineup, not a March 2027 one.
